page.overview:
Who is Scumocide?

Scumocide, known in Japan as , is a character that appears in the game Captain Commando, serving as the main antagonist and final boss of the game. He is fought in Stage 9: Callisto.

Scumocide is an alien genetic engineer with ambitions of ruling the galaxy. He discovered a way to turn people into "Super Criminals" through genetic manipulation, enhancing them to become many times stronger and faster than ordinary humans. Through this he created an army and sent them to take over earth while he monitored from the comfort of his satellite station, Callisto. He is responsible for the death of Captain Commando's parents and for the destruction Mack the Knife's home planet. The two would team up along with Ginzu the Ninja and Baby Head to put and end to the diabolic scheme, eventually leading the Commando Team to infiltrate Callisto and defeat Scumocide.

Scumocide is a tall shirtless and imposing muscular humanoid with a blank white eye and a monocle. He has a pair of tubes implanted in his head and goes barefoot.

Scumocide moves by floating and fights by using both fire and ice-based attacks, and can't be knocked down by normal attacks.
